sobre.resumo: I'm Francine, a Software Engineering student and a Full Stack developer in training. I have hands-on experience with personal projects, volunteer projects, and freelance projects — creating responsive interfaces, developing and integrating APIs, and implementing systems such as Stripe.
sobre.resumo1: I have worked in agile teams focused on accessibility, dynamic forms, and real-impact solutions. I seek to continue growing as a developer, combining my enthusiasm for continuous learning with challenges in both front-end and back-end development.
